defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Savage
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Grabbed or Restrained by the wyvern critically fails a skill check to Escape

Effect The wyvern makes a stinger Strike against the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Powerful Dive
offensiveAbilities.description: The wyvern Flies up to their fly Speed and must both move forward at least 20 feet and descend at least 10 feet. If they end the movement within melee reach of at least one enemy their size or smaller, they can make a claw Strike against that enemy. If the claw hits, as a free action, the wyvern can either automatically Grab the target or knock it Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Punishing Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The wyvern Grabbed a creature this turn using Powerful Dive

Effect The wyvern can Fly at half Speed while holding the creature in their claws, carrying that creature along with them and dropping it at the end of their movement. Alternatively, the wyvern can Strike the creature with their stinger with a +2 circumstance bonus.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wyvern Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

Stage 2 3d6 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

Stage 3 4d6 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
